# Sprite Flow

> AI sprite and character-animation toolkit for game developers. Generate 8-direction character turnarounds, top-down sprite sheets, and animated game assets from a single reference image.

Sprite Flow turns one character image into game-ready assets — 8-direction or 4-direction turnarounds with auto frame slicing, transparent backgrounds, and sprite-sheet export. Built for RPG, tactics, top-down, and isometric projects.

## Core tools

- [8-Direction Sprite Generator](https://spriteflow.io/direction-sprite-generator): Turn one character image into a full 8-way or 4-way turnaround. AI generation, auto frame slicing, optional transparent backgrounds. Outputs sprite sheet + per-frame ZIP.
- [Batch NPC Generator](https://spriteflow.io/batch-npc-generator): Generate a roster of style-consistent NPCs from a single reference. Useful for RPG and tactics projects that need dozens of distinct characters with shared visual language.
- [Game Prop Generator](https://spriteflow.io/game-prop-generator): AI tool for generating weapons, items, potions, gear, and other in-world props with consistent style. Outputs ready-to-import game-asset images.
- [Game Map Generator](https://spriteflow.io/game-map-generator): Build top-down and isometric game maps and scene tiles from prompts or reference images.
- [Game Character Creator](https://spriteflow.io/game-character-creator): Create a game-ready character portrait or design sheet from structured RPG, tactics, top-down, platformer, visual novel, or cozy-game inputs.
